meta.source: spire-codex clean A10 v0.111.0 replays with replay_version 7 (E104); Sim.exact on the human's actions, exact prefix
meta.kinds: hallway / elite / boss (data/catalog.json); event fights only in all

metrics.energy_bound: cards left in hand at end of turn with cost > energy left / cards left with cost >= 0
metrics.draw_bound: turns ending with >= 1 energy and no card of cost 0..energy left (cost -1: Unplayable and X-cost, never affordable)
metrics.wasted: energy left on draw-bound turns / all turns
metrics.basic: energy paid for STRIKE_* / DEFEND_* plays / all energy paid (human plays)
metrics.played: human card plays per ended turn
metrics.hand: cards in hand at end of turn

meta.ref: per (run, act) value: [p10, p25, p50, p75, p90] over runs with >= min_turns_ref ended turns in the act
